trainer.cobblemonrlm.solo_ace.name: Solo Ace
trainer.cobblemonrlm.solo_ace.lose: Come back when your team is sharper.
trainer.cobblemonrlm.solo_ace.arrival: I am at %s %s %s. Do not keep me waiting.
trainer.cobblemonrlm.solo_ace.busy: I am already around here. Open your eyes.
trainer.cobblemonrlm.duo_tacticien.name: Doubles Tactician
trainer.cobblemonrlm.duo_tacticien.battl: Two fronts at once. Good luck.
trainer.cobblemonrlm.duo_tacticien.win: You handled both flanks. Nicely done.
trainer.cobblemonrlm.duo_tacticien.lose: You only watched half the field.
trainer.cobblemonrlm.trio_marathon.name: Triples Marathoner
trainer.cobblemonrlm.trio_marathon.battl: Three at a time, and my team does not heal between attempts.
trainer.cobblemonrlm.trio_marathon.win: You wore me down. Well deserved.
trainer.cobblemonrlm.trio_marathon.lose: Try again: my Pokémon will keep their wounds.
trainer.cobblemonrlm.debutant.name: Rookie
trainer.cobblemonrlm.skin_par_uuid.name: UUID Skin Trainer
trainer.cobblemonrlm.skin_par_uuid.battl: My looks come from a UUID, not a username.
trainer.cobblemonrlm.skin_texture.name: Wandering Adventurer
trainer.cobblemonrlm.skin_texture.battle: My skin ships with this pack - no Mojang account behind it.
trainer.cobblemonrlm.skin_texture.lose: The road is long. Train, then find me again.
trainer.cobblemonrlm.polyglotte.name: The Polyglot
trainer.cobblemonrlm.polyglotte.battle_s: I speak your language - this text comes from the resource pack.
trainer.cobblemonrlm.polyglotte.lose: Try again once you have trained a little.
trainer.cobblemonrlm.formes.name: Form Collector
trainer.cobblemonrlm.formes.battle_start: Every one of mine wears a different form. Aspects, not species.
trainer.cobblemonrlm.formes.win: Regional or not, you read them all correctly.
trainer.cobblemonrlm.formes.lose: Learn the forms, then come back.
trainer.cobblemonrlm.champion_unique.bat: One chance. Beat me and you never see me again.
trainer.cobblemonrlm.champion_unique.win: Take these - you have earned every one of them.
trainer.cobblemonrlm.champion_unique.los: Not this time. But the door is still open.
trainer.cobblemonrlm.recompense_unique.b: Spar with me whenever you like - the prize only comes once.
trainer.cobblemonrlm.recompense_unique.w: Good work. Come back for another round any time.
trainer.cobblemonrlm.recompense_unique.l: Shake it off and challenge me again.
trainer.cobblemonrlm.jacinthe.name: Jacinthe
trainer.cobblemonrlm.jacinthe.greeting: The hall is empty and the orchestra is waiting. Shall we?
trainer.cobblemonrlm.jacinthe.decline: The orchestra will wait. Do not make it wait too long.
trainer.cobblemonrlm.jacinthe.battle_sta: Listen closely: this theme only plays for battles that matter.
trainer.cobblemonrlm.jacinthe.win: You held on to the very last bar. Hats off.
trainer.cobblemonrlm.jacinthe.lose: The music stops here. Come back ready to finish it.
trainer.cobblemonrlm.champion_unique.loc: The champion only faces those who have beaten Jacinthe - and brought a diamond.
trainer.cobblemonrlm.maitre_cache.name: The Hidden Master
trainer.cobblemonrlm.maitre_cache.battle: Nobody told you I was here. You worked it out.
trainer.cobblemonrlm.maitre_cache.win: So the league had one more door after all.
trainer.cobblemonrlm.maitre_cache.lose: Come back when the whole league has fallen.
advancement.cobblemonrlm.ligue.title: League cleared
advancement.cobblemonrlm.ligue.descripti: Defeat the three champions of the pack.
